title: CBSE KVS, NVS, EMRS Tier II Result Notice 2026
postName: KVS / NVS / EMRS Teaching & Non-Teaching Posts – Tier-II Examination
vacancyDetails: Result notice for Tier-II examination conducted for Kendriya Vidyalaya Sangathan (KVS), Navodaya Vidyalaya Samiti (NVS) and Eklavya Model Residential Schools (EMRS) recruitment
qualification: As per post-wise KVS / NVS / EMRS recruitment rules (PRT, TGT, PGT and other posts)
ageLimit: As per respective KVS / NVS / EMRS advertisements
selectionProcess: Tier-I Examination → Tier-II Examination → Interview / Skill Test (as applicable) → Final Merit
documentsRequired: Application number / roll number; educational certificates, CTET (where required), category certificate, photo ID
howToApply:
1. Visit https://www.cbse.gov.in or the recruitment result portal linked in the notice
2. Open KVS / NVS / EMRS Tier-II Result Notice 2026
3. Download PDF or login to check scorecard
4. Note shortlist status and next stage instructions
5. Keep documents ready for further process
shortDescription: CBSE has issued KVS, NVS, EMRS Tier II Result Notice 2026. Check official notice and score updates on cbse.gov.in.
content:
Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) has published the Tier-II Result Notice 2026 for recruitment examinations related to KVS, NVS and EMRS.

The notice covers result declaration / scorecard availability for candidates who appeared in the Tier-II stage of teaching and non-teaching recruitment.

Organizations covered

  • KVS – Kendriya Vidyalaya Sangathan
  • NVS – Navodaya Vidyalaya Samiti
  • EMRS – Eklavya Model Residential Schools

Next steps

  • Download the official result notice PDF
  • Check roll number / score status
  • Follow interview / document verification schedule if shortlisted

Use only official CBSE / recruitment portals for result download.
